intentions.title: Prove and ship an Obsidian-style continuous-canvas editor: one ProseMirror document spanning a whole run of prose blocks, replacing per-block editors so cross-block caret movement, multi-block selection, Enter-split and Backspace-merge come free from StarterKit's native block+ doc model
intentions.evidence: canvas/index.js header comment (Phase-4 S1): '<bp-paper-canvas> mounts ONE TipTap instance over a CONTIGUOUS run of PROSE blocks'; run-convert.js S0 projector runToTiptap/runToOps; staged rollout comments (S1 cross-block editing -> S2/S3 non-prose atoms -> S10 columns/section/terminal containers -> P4 autocomplete -> P5 command palette + source mode).

intentions.title: Guarantee every non-prose block type in the PortableDoc schema (divider, callout, card, note, stage, code, diagram, field-*, action, sheet, embed, fleet widgets, figure, task-list, table, columns, section, terminal, opaque carry) has a first-class, editable-in-place node-view inside the canvas, so no block kind forces a run split unless truly necessary
intentions.evidence: canvas/index.js imports and registers ~25 node extensions (Divider, Callout, Card, Note, Stage, Code, Diagram, Field, Action, Sheet, Embed, Fleet, Figure, TaskList, role nodes, BpTable*, Columns/Column/ColumnAtom, Section, Opaque, Terminal/TerminalAtom); run-convert.js's growing CANVAS_ATOM_TYPES/CANVAS_CONTENT_TYPES/CANVAS_ATTR_ATOM_TYPES/CANVAS_FIELD_TYPES/CANVAS_READONLY_ATOM_TYPES/CANVAS_FLEET_TYPES/CANVAS_CONTAINER_TYPES sets, each with a 'KEEP LOCKSTEP with paper_canvas.ex' comment tying client sets to a server partition.

intentions.title: Every canvas edit must diff losslessly back into the server's existing op vocabulary (patch-block / insert-after / append-block / remove-block / move-block) byte-identically to the per-block editor's convert.js path, never reinventing the diff or drifting from the server's patch.ex contract
intentions.evidence: run-convert.js imports blockToTiptap/buildPatchBlockOp/tiptapToBlock from ../convert.js verbatim ('an interior edit emitted here is BYTE-IDENTICAL to what the per-block editor emits'); explicit mapping to patch.ex op shapes (patch-block, insert-after, append-block, remove-block, move-block) documented at the top of run-convert.js; normalizeCanvasDoc in index.js exists specifically to close attr-presence/duplicate-id gaps so runToOps never mis-diffs.

intentions.title: Land the canvas as a strictly additive, zero-risk parallel implementation that cannot regress the shipped per-block <bp-paper-editor> — S0 (run-convert.js) 'ships dark' with nothing importing it, and the canvas is a second custom element wired in with one import line
intentions.evidence: run-convert.js: 'It SHIPS DARK. Nothing imports it... The working per-block <bp-paper-editor> and its committed bundle literally cannot regress because this module is unreachable at runtime.'; index.js: 'ADDITIVE: this is the SECOND custom element in the same bundle... The shipped <bp-paper-editor> behavior is byte-unchanged.'

intentions.title: Enforce Barkpark's doctrine template-lock and constraint-vocabulary laws (locked mandated blocks like title/featured-image can never be deleted or moved; cardinality/order constraints can never be violated) live, at the ProseMirror transaction layer, as a real-time client-side backstop to the server's authoritative veto
intentions.evidence: locks.js (pdd-t2): lockedNodeId/lockedIndexMap/transactionVetoesLock pure predicates, 'the FELT half of the server backstop (patch.ex:192-274)'; constraints.js (pdd-t20c) generalizes to cardinality/order; wired into a bpLockVeto Extension's filterTransaction plugin in index.js, exempting only programmatic applies.

intentions.title: Port Obsidian-analog authoring affordances into the canvas — [[wikilink and #tag autocomplete, a '/' slash-insert menu, a fuzzy Cmd-P command palette, and a Markdown 'source mode' toggle — each reusing existing per-block editor machinery verbatim rather than reimplementing it
intentions.evidence: index.js P4 section reuses WikilinkMenu/parseOpenWikilink/parseOpenTag from ../wikilink-menu.js and ../wikilink-trigger.js 'verbatim'; P4 S-slash reuses SlashMenu/SLASH_ITEMS from ../slash-menu.js filtered via slash-insert.js's CANVAS_SLASH_TYPES allowlist; P5 command-palette.js is 'a THIN subclass of SlashMenu' with insertSlashTypeAtSelection shared with the slash pick for default_block parity; P5 source mode uses blocksToMarkdown/markdownToBlocks (../markdown.js) + source-realign.js's LCS-based id realignment to keep diffs minimal on exit.

intentions.title: Keep client-side canvas type/shape enumerations (which block kinds are atoms, content nodes, attr-atoms, field control-atoms, read-only atoms, fleet widgets, containers) in exact lockstep with the server's paper_canvas.ex partition logic, so the client and server never diverge on which blocks join a run vs. split it
intentions.evidence: Repeated 'KEEP LOCKSTEP with paper_canvas.ex @canvas_*_types' comments across run-convert.js for every type set (CANVAS_CONTENT_TYPES, CANVAS_ATTR_ATOM_TYPES, CANVAS_FIELD_TYPES, CANVAS_READONLY_ATOM_TYPES, CANVAS_FLEET_TYPES, CANVAS_CONTAINER_TYPES, CANVAS_ACTION_TYPES, CANVAS_FIGURE_TYPES, CANVAS_TASK_LIST_NODE_NAME); e.g. task-list's presence-of-query discriminant explicitly mirrors task_resolver.ex:139-159.
